heuristics.statement: The first-block chaining values behave as independent uniform 256-bit values. Within one chaining value, the 2^26 values F(a0) behave as iid uniform words jointly independent of post-filter/tail labels and fresh reservoir coins. Conditional on a bucket of size n, Algorithm R retains a uniform min(n,7)-subset; therefore every fixed candidate-label first moment is multiplied by one common rho. The exact retained mean is 6.33626861212226023369 entries per bucket.
heuristics.scope: The retained population, 1.980083941 claws per scan word, first-moment reservoir transfer, cross-CV independence and Bernstein cap.
heuristics.extrapolation: The exact reservoir reduction is proved in A.15.5 and finite-checked by the transfer experiment. The frozen 200-CV panel used the full 2^26 build and 2^20 scan words per CV: 10,631,835,913 retained entries, 415,269,109 exact claws, and zero structural errors or cap aborts.
heuristics.limitations: The random-map and cross-CV independence assertions are score-critical premises about SHA-256. The reservoir theorem is conditional on them. The panel does not cover complete 2^32 scans or all N_CV values.

Under H1 the uniform-reservoir lemma preserves every fixed joint-law good-pair first moment. The historical conditional list law is different and is handled separately by H2's 0.20-bit allowance.

heuristics.extrapolation: The reduced fixtures rebuild every emitted claw and post-filter flag. The frozen panel's observed/exact cumulative-rate ratios were 1.000191, 0.999613, 1.000054 and 0.998457; every rate lay inside its predeclared 99% cluster interval.
heuristics.limitations: The transfer remains conditional on H1. The full panel scans 2^20 words per CV and does not measure the accepted tail.

heuristics.statement: The registered historical list-law bound is q3_Q >= 2^-96.0791. The online good-pair law is uniform on all (a1,a0) satisfying C1,C2,G, whereas the registered generator chose a1 uniformly and then a0 conditional on G. A separately declared 0.20-bit paired-law allowance gives q3_P >= 2^-96.2791 and q0 = q3_P*2^32/160 = 2^-71.6010280949 per retained good pair.
heuristics.scope: The accepted-pair first moment and hence N_CV.
heuristics.extrapolation: An exhaustive degree scan reproduces |C1&C2|=53,096,854, total G incidence 57,726,359,870,197 and nonconstant degrees 364,288..1,798,400. A source-frozen post-discovery study used 24 preregistered shards and 288 paired SMC replicates: mean ratio -0.01178 bit, one-sided 99% Student endpoint -0.13747, above the fixed -0.20 gate, with zero rebuild failures. Two organizer panels execute the correct joint sampler as supporting observations.
heuristics.limitations: The inherited q3 level, A0-to-P1 adjustment and row-18 relaxation transfer retain their original Monte Carlo assumptions. The new study was designed after the law mismatch was found; Student calibration and finite-seed SMC transfer to the full deterministic family are additional score-critical heuristics. No complete about-2^-71 event is directly observed.

heuristics.statement: Conditional on the exposed table-selection sigma-field, endpoint-disjoint representatives have independent accepted-tail indicators with one common p >= q0=2^-71.6010280949; shared-endpoint pairs form one group. H3 also declares E[L]>=(1-2^-9)E[K]. Coupling iid Bernoulli(q0) proxies and L<=G_max=2^32*20*4*7 gives E[J0(J0-1)]/E[J0] <= q0*G_max = 2^-30.4717450779. Thus (1-2^-9)(1-q0*G_max/2) > 1-2^-8.5.
heuristics.scope: The representative first-moment loss and per-CV Bonferroni factor 1-2^-8.5.
heuristics.extrapolation: The full-event independence/common-p premise is inherited for the unchanged P1 tail from eligible parent 711c4bf8. The new reduction conditions on arbitrary correlated reservoir selection and uses a deterministic G_max. The random-incidence group-loss forecast is 0.00108507, or 0.00137965 after the panel's 1.271481 spread, below 2^-9; the panel observed 3/5555.
heuristics.limitations: Complete rows-17-through-37 accepted-event independence with common p remains an inherited score-critical premise. The 2^-9 representative-loss bound is a random-incidence extrapolation; 2^20-word panel scans do not test full-scan repeated-a0 incidence. The exact transfer checker proves neither heuristic.

heuristics.statement: On the 256-bit RAM, every intended u32 value is explicitly reduced with AND MASK32 before a SHA, nonlinear, shift, address or table-target boundary. Four logical seven-entry buckets are transposed in place into two guarded 14-lane tag words and two exact 26-bit-payload words; a separator bit prevents inter-group borrow. The eight class/path complete-u costs are ordinary 267/267/527/527 and straddle 547/847/1127/827. Direct physical tag-address chaining costs ADD;AND;LOAD at each of 19 later heads and removes 38 operations per u. Fixed scan work is exactly 401.296875/u. A match handler is charged 28; post-filter segments are 10/25/33/33; Step-3b is 3,178 plus a 20-operation continuation wrapper. Build work is 80 mean and 2,200 maximum per insert; reset is 5 per bucket and the combined normalize/transpose is charged 512 per four-bucket block.
heuristics.scope: The binding transposed-table mean, deterministic maximum, Bernstein cap, total computation and time bound.
heuristics.extrapolation: The inherited typed checker materializes 2,101 operations and reports zero CFG/state/semantic/u32/body mismatches. The final executable supplement checks 1,572,864 exact tag-role cases, 112 payload round trips, 57,344 structured packed entries, separator behavior, wrap-boundary address identities, all eight cost rows and the final ledger. Separate complete-domain C audits enumerated all 2^23 base buckets on both paths and all 2^32 scan words; the proof gives their algorithm, counts and hashes. The final exact total is 33,344,121,387,140,981,194,339,542,341 operations, or time_log2 83.3377911625996..., rounded upward to 83.33780.
heuristics.limitations: The participant execution is an abstract word-RAM verifier, not a physical full attack. Its bounded Python run samples address wrap boundaries and representative packed lanes while the self-contained algebra proves the general identities; full-domain C audit results are reproduced records rather than organizer-recomputed experiment predicates. It does not discharge H1-H3.

It includes the 268,435,584-byte table plus four guards, exact auxiliary tables, an 11 MiB executable reserve covering the 5,086,720-byte code upper bound, stack, advice, runtime and scratch, leaving 135,168 bytes below the binding peak.

heuristics.limitations: The online figure is an analytic complete word-RAM cap, not a physical full solver execution. The binding peak is inherited from the disclosed Step-1 measurement. H1-H3 remain outside the memory checker.

restrictions: Target sha256-r38-prefix-v1 exactly: SHA-256 steps 0..37 on every padded block, standard IV once, FIPS 180-4 padding, feed-forward and all eight digest words. Output is two distinct 128-byte messages sharing the first block; Step-3b accepts only equal second-block output states, so every output is a complete collision.

Algorithm: per chaining value, insert the 2^26 R9 a0 values into 2^23 logical buckets with an exact seven-entry uniform reservoir. Transpose each block of four buckets into two guarded 14-lane tag words and two exact 26-bit-payload words, copy four guards, then scan all 2^32 u words. The twenty r38 heads share q and bucket class. Straddle residues query ordinary and wrapped adjacent groups with polarity filters before C1,C2,G,F7 and Step-3b.

Machine semantics and cost: explicit MASK32 reductions remain at every u32 consumption boundary. Combined normalization/transpose costs 512 per four buckets. Complete-u class rows are ordinary 267/267/527/527 and straddle 547/847/1127/827, giving fixed scan 401.296875/u. Direct physical tag-address chaining uses ADD;AND;LOAD on each later head. Match handler 28; post-filters 10/25/33/33; Step-3b 3178 plus 20 wrapper; build 80 mean/2200 max per insert; reset 5 per bucket. N_CV=15,580,353,037,155,665; wbar=2,083,674,703,422.4625255...; one-CV maximum=8,007,028,651,854,659; total N=33,344,121,387,140,981,194,339,542,341 operations; time_log2=83.3377911625996..., rounded upward to 83.33780.

Fail-closed count and bounded-draw caps and the Bernstein work cap are charged. Their global probabilities remain within the separately subtracted 2^-60 exception reserve; the final Bernstein negative log2 exponent is 680.9548....

Success at least 0.39 is projected under the unchanged H1, H1-P1, H2-P1 and H3-P1 premises. H2 keeps the 0.20-bit transfer from q3_Q >= 2^-96.0791 to q3_P >= 2^-96.2791. H3 keeps the 2^-9 representative-loss charge and endpoint-disjoint full-tail independence/common-p premise. The table transpose and address chain do not strengthen these explicit score-critical heuristics.

Memory uses the Step-1 peak 286,433,280 bytes, declared as 28.094. The online cap is 286,298,112 bytes; table plus guards is 268,435,584 bytes; code upper bound 5,086,720 bytes fits the 11 MiB executable reserve; advice upper bound 50,608 bytes fits 64 KiB. Score from rounded claims is 91.43180, 0.51680 bit below the live incumbent 91.94860. The package is ready for exploratory review; no qualification, human acceptance or physical full-scale execution is asserted.
